mapper.sql: m.del_flag = 0 and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and not exists ( select 1 from mms_merchant sibling where sibling.member_id = m.member_id and sibling.id <> m.id and sibling.del_flag = 0 and sibling.status = 1 and sibling.account_status = 1 ) and exists ( select 1 from cms_registration r where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.payment_status in (2, 4) and ( (r.owner_type = 1 and exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = r.owner_id and t.del_flag = 0 and (t.product_type is null or t.product_type <> 2) and (t.member_id = m.member_id or exists ( select 1 from cms_registration_merchant rm where rm.topic_id = t.id and rm.member_id = m.member_id and rm.audit_status = 1 and rm.del_flag = 0 )) )) or (r.owner_type = 2 and exists ( select 1 from cms_activity a left join cms_topic at on at.id = a.topic_id where a.id = r.owner_id and a.member_id = m.member_id and a.del_flag = 0 and (at.id is null or at.product_type is null or at.product_type <> 2) )) ) )

m.id as merchant_row_id, m.member_id as merchant_owner_member_id, coalesce(nullif(m.name, ''), '商家') as merchant_name, m.logo as merchant_logo, exists ( select 1 from merchant_crm_marketing_consent c where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.merchant_row_id = m.id and c.channel = 'IN_APP' and c.event_type = 'OPT_IN' and c.id = (select max(latest.id) from merchant_crm_marketing_consent latest where latest.member_id = c.member_id and latest.merchant_row_id = c.merchant_row_id and latest.channel = c.channel) ) as in_app_opted_in, exists ( select 1 from merchant_crm_marketing_consent c where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.merchant_row_id = m.id and c.channel = 'COUPON' and c.event_type = 'OPT_IN' and c.id = (select max(latest.id) from merchant_crm_marketing_consent latest where latest.member_id = c.member_id and latest.merchant_row_id = c.merchant_row_id and latest.channel = c.channel) ) as coupon_opted_in
mapper.select: select from mms_merchant m where order by m.id desc
select from mms_merchant m where m.id = #{merchantRowId} and limit 1

select id, member_id, merchant_id, merchant_row_id, channel, event_type, request_id, create_time from merchant_crm_marketing_consent where member_id = #{memberId} and merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1

select id, member_id, merchant_id, merchant_row_id, channel, event_type, request_id, create_time from merchant_crm_marketing_consent c where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.merchant_id = #{ownerMemberId} and c.merchant_row_id = #{merchantRowId} and c.channel = #{channel} and c.event_type = 'OPT_IN' and c.id = (select max(latest.id) from merchant_crm_marketing_consent latest where latest.member_id = c.member_id and latest.merchant_row_id = c.merchant_row_id and latest.channel = c.channel) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_crm_marketing_consent (member_id, merchant_id, merchant_row_id, channel, event_type, request_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{merchantOwnerMemberId}, #{merchantRowId}, #{channel}, #{eventType}, #{requestId}, now())
